title: Spiral Staircase Dream
description: A woman in an elegant dark gown and jeweled headpiece descends a grand spiral staircase that curves through a surreal, flooded fantasy hall. The scene is filled with floating jellyfish, a submerged grand piano, dripping crimson curtains, classical figures in the background, and a glowing ornate chandelier hovering above dark reflective water.
prompt: A woman in a flowing dark purple gown and jeweled headpiece descends a dramatic spiral staircase inside a flooded, decaying classical hall. Floating bioluminescent jellyfish illuminate the scene, a grand piano sits partially submerged in dark reflective water below, ornate chandelier hangs in mid-air, tattered red curtains drip from above, classical figures appear in the misty background, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, cinematic lighting
